# help createfileshare
createfileshare - create a fileshare and export it to a client.

SYNTAX
    createfileshare [options] <filesystem_name> <share_name>

DESCRIPTION
    The createfileshare command creates a fileshare for NFS protocols and
     optionally exports it to one or more client IPs specified.

AUTHORITY
    Super, Edit
    Any role granted the fileshare_create right

OPTIONS
    -option
        Specifies client access parameters to be set for the share being created.
        Use comma to separate multiple options.

        Following options are supported:
            ro
                Specifies that the fileshare will be exported to client as read-only.

            rw
                Specifies that the fileshare will be exported to client as read-write.
                If not specified, it will be exported to client as read-write.
                The default access permissions for fileshare is read-write.

            root_squash
                Map requests from UID/GID 0 to the anonymous UID/GID. Note that this does
                not apply to any other UIDs or GIDs that might be equally sensitive, such
                as user "bin" or group "staff"

            no_root_squash
                Turn off root squashing.

            all_squash
                Map all UIDs and GIDs to the anonymous user.

        This is the default option that will be applied: sync, wdelay,
        sec=sys, subtree_check, secure, hide, root_squash, rw.

     -ipaddr
        Specifies the client IP address that can access the share.
        Use comma to separate the IP addresses.
        Use "*" to allow access to share by any client.
        Use 192.168.1.0/24 for multiple clients to have access to shares in a subnet.

SPECIFIERS
    <filesystem_name>
        Specifies a filesystem name in which the share should be created.

    <share_name>
        Specifies a fileshare name up to 255 characters in length.

NOTES
    A filesystem needs to be created before creating a fileshare.
    Use createfilesystem command to create a filesystem.

    Verify the creation of fileshares by issuing the showfileshare command.

    Maximum of one share can be created in a filesystem.

EXAMPLES
    Creating a fileshare named demo_share in filesystem demo_fs

        cli% createfileshare demo_fs demo_share

    Creating a fileshare named demo_share in filesystem demo_fs
    and export it to NFS client 10.31.51.21 with read write permissions

        cli% createfileshare -ipaddr 10.31.51.21 demo_fs demo_share

    Creating a fileshare named demo_share in filesystem demo_fs
    and export it to NFS client 10.31.51.21 with read only permissions

        cli% createfileshare -option ro -ipaddr 10.31.51.21 demo_fs demo_share
